resources.string: Cinema turns on whenever your phone is in landscape: sound stays anchored to the screen, dialogue is locked to its centre, effects spread wider and further back, and the added delay is lower for lip-sync.
Cinema is always on: sound anchored to the screen, dialogue locked to its centre, wide effects, lower delay.
Music settings are used in landscape too.

Every instrument gets its own fixed place around you, re-rendered in real time, and players that don\'t announce themselves are found too. Needs permission to share audio: nothing is recorded or stored. Pause keeps it, so you\'re only asked again after Turn Off or a restart.
Works with every app and needs no special permission. Head tracking is applied directly to the sound, with no added delay.
Tip: keep Dolby Atmos on in Standard. Dolby puts the sound around you, Spatial5 moves it with your head.
Tip: turn Dolby Atmos off while Immersive 3D is on, so the sound isn\'t virtualised twice.
Finds the best stage and room for each song
Follows your head with the front camera, even when the phone sits still on a desk or stand. Frames are analysed on the phone and never stored.
Uses only the phone\'s motion sensors, no camera. Best with the phone in your pocket, so it turns when you do.
Sound stays put even when the phone moves
Cinema is on: sound follows the screen
Scene slowly follows you to a new direction
Pause Camera When Screen Is Off
Want more? Immersive 3D gives every instrument its own place around you and can also pick up players that don\'t announce themselves. It asks for permission to share audio.
Phone motion can\'t see your head turn while the phone sits still. Face tracking can: it uses the front camera, and frames never leave the phone.
Camera not allowed: using phone motion.
Audio sharing not allowed: using Standard.

Spatial5 works without the camera and without audio sharing. Each one unlocks more: the camera follows your head even when the phone is still, and audio sharing enables Immersive 3D. If you turn on Immersive 3D and Android asks to share your screen, choose \"Entire screen\": only audio is used, nothing is recorded, and the app has no internet access.
HRTF data: MIT Media Lab KEMAR (Gardner & Martin). Head model: \"Lee Perry-Smith\" scan by Infinite Realities, CC BY 3.0.
